description: Implement Timesheet View -- a new workspace-scoped page with weekly/monthly grid showing technician x day hours aggregated from service logs, with filters and totals
steps: Create the API endpoint: Add a new endpoint `GET /api/workspaces/<slug>/service-reports/timesheet/` in apps/api/plane/app/views/service_reports/base.py that aggregates ServiceLog data grouped by author and worked_on date, within a date range from query params. Return a structure like {rows: [{author_id, author_name, days: {date_str: {logged_hours, equivalent_hours}}, total_logged, total_equivalent}], column_totals: {date_str: {logged_hours, equivalent_hours}}, grand_total: {...}}. Permission: ADMIN and MEMBER.
Register the new endpoint in apps/api/plane/app/urls/service_reports.py with path `workspaces/<str:slug>/service-reports/timesheet/`.
Export the new view class in apps/api/plane/app/views/service_reports/__init__.py and in apps/api/plane/app/views/__init__.py.
Add TypeScript types for the timesheet response in packages/types/src/service-reports.ts (TServiceTimesheetReport, TTimesheetRow, etc).

Create the timesheet frontend components directory at apps/web/core/components/service-timesheet/ with: index.ts, timesheet-page.tsx (main container with filters and grid), timesheet-grid.tsx (the responsive grid/table component), timesheet-toolbar.tsx (period navigation and filters).

The timesheet-page.tsx should: use SWR to fetch timesheet data, provide week/month toggle, prev/next navigation for period, optional project filter and author filter. Use the existing useReportFilters pattern from service-reports.

The timesheet-grid.tsx should: render a table/grid with rows for each technician, columns for each day in the period, cells showing hours (logged_hours_display). Include row totals and column totals. Responsive: on mobile stack as a list of cards (one per technician per day). On desktop show the full grid.
Create the route page: apps/web/app/(all)/[workspaceSlug]/(projects)/service-timesheet/layout.tsx and page.tsx following the pattern from service-reports/[tabId]/layout.tsx.
Register the route in apps/web/app/routes/core.ts following the service-reports pattern.
Add the sidebar navigation item in apps/web/core/components/workspace/sidebar/workspace-menu.tsx with key 'service-timesheet', access ADMIN and MEMBER only.

Add i18n translations in packages/i18n/src/locales/en/navigation.json and pt-BR/navigation.json for the sidebar label, and add a service-timesheet.json locale file (or keys in service-reports.json) for page labels, column headers, etc.
acceptance_criteria: A new API endpoint /api/workspaces/<slug>/service-reports/timesheet/ returns aggregated hours by author and date
The timesheet page is accessible at /:workspaceSlug/service-timesheet/ and shows in the workspace sidebar
The grid shows technicians as rows, days as columns, with hours in each cell
Row totals (per technician) and column totals (per day) are displayed
Week/month period navigation works (prev/next buttons change the date range)
Filters by project and author are available
The layout is responsive: grid on desktop, stacked cards on mobile
Only ADMIN and MEMBER can access (GUEST is excluded)
Lint passes on all new files
